# See & Do France

> > A comprehensive travel guide to France's iconic landmarks, monuments, museums, and cultural attractions from Paris to Normandy.

See & Do France provides detailed visitor guides to France's most famous destinations including the Eiffel Tower, Palace of Versailles, and D-Day beaches, alongside insights into French history, culture, and national holidays. The site covers everything from Parisian landmarks and world-class museums to regional attractions and WWII commemoration sites.

## Key Topics

- Paris landmarks and monuments
- Palace of Versailles
- Eiffel Tower
- French Revolution history
- World War II sites and D-Day beaches
- French museums (Louvre, Musée d'Orsay)
- Arc de Triomphe
- Normandy historical sites
- French national holidays and traditions
- Monaco and Prince's Palace
- French gardens and parks
- Gothic and neoclassical architecture
- Châteaux and palaces
- French cultural heritage
- Tourist attractions and sightseeing

## Essential Paris Landmarks

- [The Eiffel Tower](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/eiffel-tower.html): Eiffel Tower visitor guide covering Gustave Eiffel's iconic Paris landmark
- [Palace of Versailles](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/palace-of-versailles.html): Versailles visitor guide with Hall of Mirrors, gardens, and admission tips
- [Le Panthéon](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/le-pantheon.html): Le Panthéon Paris monument guide with neoclassical architecture and tombs
- [Place de la Bastille](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/place-de-la-bastille.html): Place de la Bastille Paris guide with French Revolution history and cafes

## French Landmarks & Monuments

- [French Landmarks](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/french-landmarks.html): Comprehensive guide to French landmarks including Champs-Élysées and more
- [French Monuments](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/famous-french-monuments.html): Guide to French monuments including Eiffel Tower, palaces, and châteaux
- [Palace of the Popes](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/palace-of-the-popes.html): Avignon's Palace of the Popes with medieval Gothic architecture and history
- [The Prince's Palace](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/princes-palace.html): Monaco's Prince's Palace visitor guide featuring Grace Kelly history

## Museums & Cultural Attractions

- [Museums](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/museums-in-france.html): French museums guide featuring the Louvre, Musée d'Orsay, and Pompidou
- [Tourist Attractions in France](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/tourist-attractions-in-france.html): France attractions guide: Moulin Rouge, ski resorts, parks, and entertainment
- [Gardens](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/french-gardens.html): Guide to French gardens and parks including Jardin Anglais and Botanique

## World War II Historical Sites

- [D-Day Beaches](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/d-day-beaches.html): Normandy D-Day beaches guide covering WWII historical sites and memorials
- [VE Day](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/ve-day.html): Explains VE Day (Victory in Europe Day) and its WWII commemoration in France

## French Culture & Holidays

- [The Flag](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/french-flag.html): History and meaning of French Tricolor flag from French Revolution era
- [May Day & Labor Day](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/may-day.html): Covers May Day and Labor Day celebrations in France with lily-of-the-valley
- [Armistice Day](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/armistice-day.html): Armistice Day (Veterans Day) WWI remembrance traditions in France
- [Regional French Flags](https://www.see-and-do-france.com/french-flags.html): Regional French flags guide covering Alsace, Brittany, and other regions
